basic_info.description: Ideally located just steps from Union Square, this stunning home combines the energy of downtown San Francisco with the comfort of a private retreat. Set within a well-kept, professionally managed building, the residence showcases tremendous natural light throughout and a thoughtful floor plan designed for both style and convenience.    The home features two spacious Bedrooms and one full Bathroom, complemented by a bright Living Room and Dining Room with oversized windows that frame the city backdrop. A well-appointed Kitchen provides generous cabinetry and counter space, making it as functional as it is inviting. Both Bedrooms offer ample closet space, ensuring comfort for full-time living or weekend stays. Adding to its appeal are rare urban amenities: dedicated Parking for one car, large private Storage, and elevator access to all floors. These practical luxuries make city living seamless and secure.    From this central location, enjoy world-class shopping, Michelin-Star dining, and San Francisco's premier theaters and landmarks all within minutes of your front door. Whether envisioned as a primary residence, investment property, or elegant pied-a-terre, this beautiful Condo captures the essence of luxury downtown living.
